messages:
Nina (Design): quick roundup from the playground usability test: the function preview + tool list is visually fine but keyboard users cant reach tool items easily.
Chris (DevEx): thanks, can you give repro steps?
Nina (Design): open fn def -> Preview -> press Tab. focus hits Close button and cycles. expected: Tab moves into tool list and arrow keys navigate tools.
Lina (Frontend): thats focus-lock behavior. easy change: set initialFocus to the tool-list container and implement a roving-tabindex for items.
Omar (A11y): agree. add role=listbox on the list, role=option per item, and an sr-only live instruction. ensure Esc closes and that dialog announces on open.
Tess (PM): product note: keep preview light. on mobile we should avoid autofocus (keyboard pop). prefer bottom-sheet pattern on small screens.
Lina (Frontend): plan: desktop side-panel with initial focus on list; mobile bottom-sheet without autofocus; add aria-describedby for keyboard hint.
Chris (DevEx): rollout plan: small PR to change initial focus + aria attrs, QA keyboard pass, ship behind flag.
CI-Bot: Added e2e tests PLG-KEY-41 and PLG-KEY-42 for keyboard navigation and escape behavior.
Nina (Design): copy nudge: visible header should be compact ("Invocation preview") with sr-only full instructions. maybe a tiny hint icon that shows on hover/focus.
Omar (A11y): icon ok if keyboardable and linked to sr-only text via aria-describedby. screen readers get full instruction.
Lina (Frontend): will add storybook knobs for keyboard flows and a small tooltip with full function name for run-history truncation.
Chris (DevEx): PR opened at gh.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/501, assigning @Lina @Omar. aiming to merge by tomorrow AM.
Tess (PM): prioritize keyboard + SR fixes first; run-history truncation is lower priority.
Nina (Design): thanks team 389 please ping if copy needs tiny edits.
